text:
Nia Gomez: Hey all, first-day question. Trying to run an older CLI that requires Rosetta and the app keeps failing with "no suitable architecture". Installer asks for admin and Kandji blocks unauthorized sudo. macOS Monterey on M1. Whats the quickest path?

rachel-it: Welcome Nia! We can either (A) push Rosetta via Kandji or (B) grant a 1-hour temp admin so you can run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. Which do you prefer?

Nia Gomez: Prefer to avoid admin if possible. Will Kandji push be fast?

sam-dev: For dev tools we usually push Rosetta + specific Intel-only binaries. If you need Homebrew x86 bottles you may also need to install Rosetta systemwide. Kandji push is usually <15m.

kandji-bot: Kandji action queued: "Install Rosetta (Apple)" targeting device Nia-Gomez-MBP.
kandji-bot: Kandji action completed at 2026-03-25T10:22:04Z.

rachel-it: Can you reboot and try the CLI again? If it still errors, we can open a temp-admin for 1 hour. @people-ops please approve auto-admin for re-install if needed.

people-ops: Approving temp admin if Kandji push didn't resolve. Please request via internal form and include reason "Rosetta needed for onboarding dev CLI".

Nia Gomez: Rebooted and CLI runs fine now. Thanks! One last quick Q: will Rosetta affect performance for other apps?

sam-dev: Rosetta only translates Intel code on launch; native ARM apps unaffected. We recommend installing ARM-native versions when available.

Nia Gomez: Great, thanks everyone!
